overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags (ShareBasedCompensation last filed FY2021, $33M). The filer's own Note 17 pre-tax series is $40M/$46M/$46M for 2023/2024/2025. The engine applies a single override value to every missing period; $46M is the FY2024 and FY2025 filed figure, and FY2024 is the median year of the 3-yr normalized base, so the base is built from the exact filed figure, with at most a $6M overstatement in FY2023 (conservative direction, ~$0.04/share).
